Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan with capabilities to steal cryptocurrency wallet data and browser cookies
Anti-VM and process checks to evade sandbox analysis
Kills browser processes to unlock user profiles for data harvesting
Steals Bitcoin and Litecoin wallet.dat files
Exfiltrates browser cookies, usernames, passwords, session data
Screenshot functionality to capture open windows
Receives commands from C2 servers to execute various malicious actions
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (due to .NET malware and %AppData% infection path)
Web browsers: Chrome, Yandex, Kometa, Amigo, Torch, Orbitum, Opera, Mozilla
Attack Vector: Malware infection via executable copied to %AppData%/NvidiaDriver.exe
Process monitoring tools detection and termination
Browser process termination to access user data
Indicators of Compromise: Malware sample hashes and domains used to drop InnfiRAT and as C2 servers (available in ThreatLabZ write-up)
Presence of wallet.dat files in %AppData%\Litecoin\ and %AppData%\Bitcoin\ folders
Processes of Process Hacker, Process Explorer, Process Monitor terminated
Killed browser processes: Chrome, Yandex, Kometa, Amigo, Torch, Orbitum, Opera, Mozilla
